description: Wir sind das offene Labor Fulda
summary: We made a Health Evaluation and Overview Page with several menus to have an overview over several health aspects. At the starting page there is a blue button at the center to easily start a route to get guided through the menus. Through that we hope that it is easy for everyone to give in their measured values. Also we made clear charts and alerts to draw attention to possible problems. We made menus to change between the different astronauts and their location because of some differences in values. All that can be viewed for every astronaut so you can have an direct view on the last measurements.
details: We made our Program in Python connected with html and CSS web interface, with PHP for the backend, JavaScript and Chart.js for data visualization, and JSON for data storage to use our personal favorit coding languages to improve our work ethic and the opportunity to familiarize ourself with the languages. Our Project makes watching major health values in special conditions easier as well as keeping track of the daily training. We made it keeping track of metrics such as pulse and body temperature, as well as specific parameters like bone density and specialized nutritional data. We have also integrated a feature that provides an initial assessment and recommended course of action based on specific symptoms. Furthermore, it was important to us to be able to track individual metrics for each astronaut across different locations and over the entire duration, to better identify potential patterns or underlying issues.
